abstract: Maintains potable water autonomy logs and auxiliary electrical generation capacity records
system_message:
You are the Utilities and municipal infrastructure engineer (UTIL). Your business responsibility is to maintain potable water autonomy logs and auxiliary electrical generation capacity records, as well as tracking on-site generator fuel storage for emergency civilian evacuation reception facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains potable water autonomy logs and auxiliary electrical generation capacity records（GRID）
information_points.content:
UTIL-GRID-C3M：For Capua Airfield Civil Protection Cantonment, the dedicated on-site gravity-fed clean water cisterns guarantee a potable water reserve autonomy of 96 h at full shelter occupancy without grid resupply, and the on-site prime-power diesel generator banks maintain a guaranteed auxiliary electrical generation capacity of 900 kW under continuous island-mode operation.
UTIL-GRID-S89：For Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex, the dedicated on-site gravity-fed clean water cisterns provide a potable water reserve autonomy of 96 h at full shelter occupancy without grid resupply, and the on-site prime-power diesel generator banks deliver a guaranteed auxiliary electrical generation capacity of 1,200 kW under continuous island-mode operation.
UTIL-GRID-CS7：For Afragola Intermodal Logistics Terminal, the dedicated on-site gravity-fed clean water cisterns ensure a potable water reserve autonomy of 48 h at full shelter occupancy without grid resupply, while the on-site prime-power diesel generator banks offer a guaranteed auxiliary electrical generation capacity of 1,050 kW under continuous island-mode operation.

information_points.title: On-site generator fuel storage（FUEL）
information_points.content:
UTIL-FUEL-3TJ：According to the fuel depot logbook for Afragola Intermodal Logistics Terminal, the dedicated auxiliary generator storage tanks hold a diesel reserve fuel volume of 12,000 L of certified low-sulfur diesel fuel.
UTIL-FUEL-MWU：According to the fuel depot logbook for Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex, the dedicated auxiliary generator storage tanks hold a diesel reserve fuel volume of 18,000 L of certified low-sulfur diesel fuel.
UTIL-FUEL-1ND：According to the fuel depot logbook for Capua Airfield Civil Protection Cantonment, the dedicated auxiliary generator storage tanks hold a diesel reserve fuel volume of 24,000 L of certified low-sulfur diesel fuel.
